blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Proposes Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) Risk-Capital Framework Effective April 1, 2027. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI proposed new CVA (credit valuation adjustment for derivative counterparty risk) Framework for derivative-related counterparty risk, effective April 1, 2027, replacing 2011 guidelines.
**Scope & Applicability:** Applies to all commercial banks except SFBs, Payments Banks, and Local Area Banks.
**Basic Approach (BA-CVA (credit valuation adjustment for derivative counterparty risk)):** Offers Full BA-CVA (recognizes eligible hedges) and Reduced BA-CVA (no hedge recognition).

**Simplified Threshold:** Banks with non-centrally cleared derivatives up to **₹10 trillion** can use simplified approach (CVA (credit valuation adjustment for derivative counterparty risk) capital req = 100% counterparty credit risk capital req).
**Counterparty Risk Weights:** Sovereigns: 0.5% (Investment Grade) and 2% (others); Financial Sector: 5% (IG) and 12% (others).
⚠️ **Exemption Trap:** SFBs, Payments Banks, and LABs are EXCLUDED from the new CVA (credit valuation adjustment for derivative counterparty risk) capital framework.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
